top_concerns: No ablation isolating the sharpness (SAM) term from truncation, noise smoothing, and trajectory reuse; gains cannot be attributed to flatness
In-domain gains over FTD/TESLA are marginal (0.1-0.5 pts) and often within standard deviation; ImageNet-1K compared only to TESLA, with no modern large-scale baselines
Theory (Prop 4.1 convexity/convergence assumptions, loose linear-in-tau Thm 4.2) does not match the non-converged practical setting; trajectory reusing changes the SAM objective
Evidence for flatness is indirect (hypergradient norm, sharpness during training), with no final-sharpness comparison; Table 8 shows extreme sensitivity to the truncation fraction (23.4 vs 50.9)
Efficiency claims overstated: memory above TESLA (5.7 vs 3.6 GB), runtime about equal to MTT, identical ImageNet-1K memory entries
